description_en: Obtain the agent service status metrics from online reports. Supports queries by instance, time range, agent, and department group
description_zh: 获取在线报表下坐席服务状态量。支持实例、时间区间、坐席、部门分组查询
kebab_example: aliyun aiccs get-agent-service-status --instance-id ccc_xp_pre-cn-000 --start-date 1615083365000 --end-date 1617761765000 --page-size 20 --current-page 1 --agent-ids 111 --dep-ids 123 --time-latitude-type minute --exist-department-grouping true --exist-agent-grouping true --api-version 2019-10-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetAgentServiceStatus
